text_block_list.text:
To the rest of the world, tonight is Christmas.
However, with the massive showdown of the Arima Kinen ahead of them, tonight is no time for the Umamusume to get caught up in the festivities.

Still, tonight was undeniably special.
I had told Oguri Cap to have fun with
her friends, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I've been waiting for you.

"She should be having a party
with Tamamo Cross and the others right about now.
Plus, the room's been decorated for Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for letting myself into your room without asking.
Consider it a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's still going on.
I just slipped away for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Because this Christmas is special.
I wanted to spend it with you, too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Before everything is decided...
I wanted to talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once I told them how I really felt,
everyone gladly saw me off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
These decorations were everyone's idea, too.
I'm truly blessed with wonderful rivals.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And besides... to a wonderful Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get our party started right away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First... what should we eat?
Creek and the others packed so much for us.

Looking closely, there really is a mountain of food here.
Cake, pizza, salad, stew, yellowtail...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer!
I'm glad you noticed that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Inari prepared it for me, saying
seasonal winter yellowtail is the best for a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How's that, it's so plump and looks delicious, doesn't it? Yeah, that's right, let's start with the yellowtail.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll turn it into sashimi, and make kabutoni with the head...
Ah, I'm getting so excited!
choice_data_list: You're going to fillet it, Oguri?
You're going to fillet it, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I can't handle them all...
Trainer, how about you?"
choice_data_list: A whole one... If we're talking a whole one...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...
I can do this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If it's me, I'm sure I can swallow it whole...!
And so, Christmas night spent with Oguri Cap deepened...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...It brings back memories. Back when I was in my hometown,
Christmas was always so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The delicious food everyone prepares,
and the lively, gentle chatter..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I never felt the cold.
Because everyone's warmth was with me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Of course, it warms my heart just as much...as it did back then."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All the tension, all the exhaustion.
It feels like it's melting it all away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to spend time with you after all.
While holding onto this warm feeling...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —I can fight in the 'Arima Kinen'.
choice_data_list: Let's take all of our memories with us!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Right, it might be late, but...
I forgot an important word."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Merry Christmas!

And so, I spent a heartwarming Christmas with Oguri Cap.
With tonight's memories in our hearts—onward to the Arima Kinen!
